sections.title: The problem I want to solve
sections.body:
Indonesia has no shortage of talented people. What many of them lack is **access**: to training that is practical rather than theoretical, affordable rather than exclusive, and available outside a few big cities.

Without it, capable people miss scholarships, jobs, and leadership roles they could have earned. My work is about closing that gap, one program and one community at a time.

sections.title: Programs I have built
sections.intro: Each program targets one gap in access to practical self-development.

items.title: Just Speak Indonesia
items.description: Public speaking and English communication training that helps people say what they mean, with confidence.

items.title: BISA Academy
items.description: A self-development academy built on one belief: with the right training, everyone can.

items.title: Mentor Lampung
items.description: Connecting young people in Lampung with mentors who have walked the path before them.

items.title: INASA Scrabble Academy
items.description: Using competitive English Scrabble to grow vocabulary, strategy, and sportsmanship.

items.title: Bloomly English for Kids
items.description: English for children through play, songs, and stories, so they grow up unafraid of the language.

items.title: Manggala Academy
items.description: Leadership and character development for young people preparing to lead their communities.

items.title: IMA Chapter Bandar Lampung
items.description: Growing the marketing community in Bandar Lampung through the Indonesia Marketing Association.

items.title: Mata Garuda Lampung
items.description: The Lampung chapter of Mata Garuda, the LPDP scholarship awardee and alumni community.

items.title: Women4women
items.description: A community where women support women to learn, earn, and lead.
